Bundles

Buy access to a predefined set of placements. No bidding. Serving is fair-share across participating brands.

SILVER
Entry
HP CB3 + L1 Categories + L2 Categories
GOLD
Core

PLATINUM
Premium
HP CB1 + Thank You Page

Bundle Catalog

Bundles are mutually exclusive. Overlap not allowed.
SILVER
No bidding
Silver Bundle
  • • Homepage: Celeb Banner 3
  • • L1 Category Pages
  • • L2 Category Pages
GOLD
High demand
Gold Bundle
  • • Homepage: Celeb Banner 2

PLATINUM
Premium
Platinum Bundle

Rules

No targeting in Bundles (access product).
Serving uses fair-share rotation across eligible brands.
Delivery/impressions are tracked at brand_id level (not asset_id) to prevent double allocation on creative swaps.
Creatives can be changed mid-month via replace flow (new creatives must be approved before swap).

Bidding Strategy

Manual Bidding

You take control of your Ads by placing bids on a Cost per Click basis.

Smart Bidding (ROAS)

Optimizes bids for maximum performance based on your ROAS target.

Smart Bidding

AI optimizes and applies the best Cost per Click bid for Maximum Performance. Bids are updated regularly for each of your products to improve performance. AI takes the heavy lifting and guesswork out of setting targets to meet your performance goals.

System automatically sets the right ROI target for your product ads based on the likelihood to result in a conversion that helps you achieve the maximum possible returns.

v3 Hierarchy Rules

  • One Primary / Performance / Display / Promo per brand
  • Sub-Wallets only under Primary
  • Promo: brand-level, never assigned to campaigns
  • Performance ↔ Display, Primary ↔ Sub-Wallet allowed
  • Promo cannot be topped up by brand or transferred out
Promo fallback (Module 12)

If any wallet (Primary, Performance, Display, or Sub-Wallet) hits ₹0, the next spend draws from the brand's Promo Wallet before campaigns pause. A Promo Fallback Draw entry is written to the ledger.

GST Invoice Trigger Configuration

Module 19 · Open Decision §B pending Finance sign-off

Open Decision §B — trigger choice unresolved

Finance prefers ON_CONSUMPTION. BRD/PRD implies ON_FUNDING. Statutory exposure differs by choice. Config below is locked to default until Finance signs off.

Current Default

ON_FUNDING

Invoice generated when wallet credit happens.

Pros: simpler implementation; clear 1:1 mapping with recharge.
Cons: may create advance-receipt GST timing exposure.
Finance preferred

ON_CONSUMPTION

Invoice generated as ads consume — daily batch.

Pros: aligns with statutory timeline for service rendering.
Cons: requires reliable consumption-tracking at invoice time.

Trigger preview

When trigger fires, the system: (1) consolidates the eligible amount per brand, (2) generates an invoice with GST line items, (3) auto-emails to the brand's registered finance contact (placeholder), (4) writes invoice ID to the linked ledger entries.

Error Catalogue — Wallet

All blocked actions in one place — for tech reference.

E-WAL-001 · Hierarchy
Sub-Wallet must be under Primary

"Sub-Wallets cannot be created under Performance, Display, or Promo. Choose Primary as the parent."

E-WAL-002 · Hierarchy
Promo Wallet is brand-level only

"Promo Wallet sits at brand level. Cannot be created under another wallet."

E-WAL-003 · Campaign
Cannot assign campaign to Promo Wallet

"Promo Wallet is fallback-only. Campaigns must be assigned to Primary, Performance, Display, or a Sub-Wallet under Primary."

E-WAL-004 · Campaign
PLA → Performance lineage

"PLA campaigns can only draw from Performance or a Sub-Wallet under Primary. Display wallet not eligible."

E-WAL-005 · Recharge
Cannot fund Promo Wallet

"Promo Wallet is org-funded only. Brands cannot top up via recharge."

E-WAL-006 · Recharge
Wallet / Payment type mismatch

"The selected wallet does not accept this payment method. Choose a different wallet or method."

E-WAL-007 · Transfer
Promo Wallet → regular wallet blocked

"Promo balance is ring-fenced. Cannot transfer out to Primary, Performance, Display, or Sub-Wallets."

E-WAL-008 · Transfer
Cross-Brand-House transfer blocked

"Inter-brand transfers are permitted only within the same Brand House. HUL → Honasa is not allowed."

E-WAL-009 · Override
Self-approval blocked

"You initiated this override. A different user with Biz/Admin or Finance role must approve."

E-WAL-010 · Override
Reason mandatory

"All admin overrides require a reason. Minimum 10 characters."

E-WAL-011 · Aging
120-day AR aging block

"Brand has outstanding invoices > 120 days old. New post-paid credit blocked. Route to Finance for override."

E-WAL-012 · TDS
TDS cert overdue · overrides blocked (Phase 2)

"Brand has overdue TDS certificates (> X days). Admin overrides blocked until Finance clears the flag."

E-WAL-013 · Recharge
Duplicate UTR (7-day rolling)

"This UTR was submitted by the same brand within the last 7 days. Confirm before resubmitting."

E-WAL-014 · Switch
Wallet switch ad-type mismatch

"PLA campaign cannot be moved to Display wallet. Switch blocked."

E-WAL-015 · Switch
Insufficient balance on new wallet

"New wallet balance (₹X) is below daily budget (₹Y). Campaign will pause immediately on switch — confirm to proceed."

E-WAL-016 · Ledger
Ledger edit / delete blocked

"Ledger is append-only. No user — including Super Admin — can modify or delete entries."
